start.placeholder: What do you want to build?

status.download: Getting the speech model, only the first time (about 0.8 GB): {{percent}}%

voice.noVoice: There's no {{language}} voice in this browser, so the answers can't be read out loud. Add one in your computer's speech settings, or choose another language.

problem.unsupported: This browser can't run the speech model. Open the factory in an up-to-date Chrome or Edge.
problem.blocked: The browser isn't allowed to use the microphone. Click the icon left of the address bar, allow the microphone, then press Talk again.
problem.noMicrophone: No microphone found. Plug one in or connect your headset, then press Talk again.
problem.microphoneBusy: Another program is using the microphone. Close it (a call, a recorder), then press Talk again.
problem.microphoneFailed: The microphone opened, but its sound couldn't be read. Reload the page and press Talk again.
problem.download: The speech model couldn't be downloaded. Check your internet connection, then press Talk again.
problem.voiceFailed: The coach's voice couldn't be played, so you won't hear its answers. Check your speakers or headphones, then press Talk again.
problem.notSent: Your words couldn't be sent. Please say them again.
